Language of instruction: The course will be given in English

The course aims to provide students with the opportunity to specialize in a specific topic within UX and XR, and to develop an advanced ability to identify and solve problems based on scientific evidence within this field. The course also provides practical experience in planning, executing, and evaluating user-centered projects in close collaboration with external partners.

In addition, the course aims to give students a broader perspective on challenges related to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, and to train them in investigative work and project management in a way that enables the project to be extended into a master’s thesis.

The course content is tailored to students previous choices and direction. Subject is selected and the project plans are submitted so that the student's previous knowledge is applied and deepened. If a project is multidisciplinary, another department could be involved in the project also.
The course is a project course based on the challenges related to the UN's sustainable goals.

The examiner, in consultation with Disability Support Services, may deviate from the regular form of examination in order to provide a permanently disabled student with a form of examination equivalent to that of a student without a disability.
